title: Ricci curvature bounds for Statistical Submersions
summary: In this paper, we study Ricci curvature bounds for statistical submersions from a direct Ricci-curvature perspective. Although Chen--Ricci inequalities for statistical submersions have already been established, a complementary lower estimate is needed to obtain a two-sided description of the Ricci curvature. Motivated by this observation, we combine the Ricci curvature relations of a statistical submersion with Hineva's algebraic inequality.
